headline: Google Signs Geothermal Energy Deal with Quaise Energy for Oregon Operations
summary: Google signed an agreement with Quaise Energy to utilize power generated from superhot rock geothermal technology at Newberry Volcano for its data center in The Dalles, Oregon.
why: Google, owned by Alphabet Inc., operates energy-intensive data center networks globally to support its cloud computing and artificial intelligence services.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Google contracted Quaise Energy to supply geothermal electricity for its Oregon data center.
